name: ENVE 4820
title: Hydraulic Engineering
description: (Also offered as CE 4820.) Design and analysis of water and wastewater transport systems, including pipelines, pumps, pipe networks, and open channel flow. Introduction to hydraulic structures and porous media hydraulics. Computer applications.
requirement_description: CE 3120 or ENVE 3120 or CHEG 3123; enrollment in the School of Engineering.
